title: Country Safety and Security Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities: 
 The Country Safety and Security Manager (CSSM) will drive safety, security, and risk management initiatives for Aga Khan Education Service, India (AKES, I) and the Aga Khan Academy, Hyderabad (AKAH). S/he will develop and implement risk-based strategies, policies, standards, and procedures in line with wider AKDN policy. A strategic safety and security perspective will be maintained through links with local organizations and official departments to inform appropriate operational level decisions for AKES, I and AKAH leadership. The CSSM has a responsibility to monitor, mentor, guide, and support safety and security staff at AKAH and the schools security focal points (SFPs) in Mumbai, Gujrat and Telangana regions. The CSSM will provide leadership with security analysis by continuously monitoring the security environment and will also inform and work under the functional guidance of the Global Safety and Security Lead (GSSL) for Aga Khan Schools. The incumbent shall work in close collaboration with the Department of International Security (DIS) of AKDN. 
 Safety and Security Management and Planning: Develop and implement a structured safety and security management system , in line with the AKDN Security Level System (SLS), and provide directions on safety and security strategy, policy, standards and procedures. Develop and implement mandated (SLS) assessments, procedures, plans, and mechanisms appropriate to regional threat levels and the schools context. Conduct audits of the schools and review safety and security mitigation measures/manage the remedial action plans. Review and implement the safety and security mitigation strategies for schools, hostels and offices, address vulnerabilities, and lead the audit process. Develop and implement the organizations strategic safety and security plans including the business continuity plans. Collect and analyze safety and security information and disseminate advisories. Oversee the implementation and ensure that the security systems and equipment, such as surveillance cameras, access control systems, and alarm systems including fire extinguishers are in working condition. Escalate to the relevant function for any resolution of issues with such system/equipments. Develop and maintain a strong contextual understanding of all AKES, I areas of operation. Oversee the planning, implementation and quality control of AKES, I security manpower, technical assets, and physical protection measures such as CCTV cameras, access control systems, alarm systems, and firefighting equipment, are appropriate, maintained and correctly utilized. 
 Incident Management: Develop at all schools critical incident management teams and prepare the team to manage critical incidents including coordination and supporting emergency services during any critical incident. Develop and maintain a Critical Incident Management Team (CIMT) and prepare contingency plans to manage critical incidents, including coordination with and support to emergency services during such events. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of safety and security measures through incident reporting, data analysis, and feedback mechanisms. Support the supervisor and CIMT in managing all safety and security aspects of incident response. In coordination with the school Safeguarding Lead implement the Safeguarding policy requirements in this respect. Develop and maintain a communications system that is robust and reliable to ensure effective communication with required services and personnel during emergencies. Gather and analyze safety and security information relevant to education/schools in areas of operations to strengthen the AKES safety and security planning and preparedness. 
 Coordination and Relationships: Work under the functional guidance and in close coordination with the AKDN Department of International Security (DIS) along with AKS Safety & Security Lead. Establish relationships with the relevant law enforcement agencies, community leaders, and emergency services to ensure their support as required. Through the school Safety and Security focal point, establish relationships with relevant local law enforcement agencies, community leaders, and emergency services to ensure their support as required Through the school Safety & Security focal point, monitor and manage the activities and performance of contracted security providers in accordance with AKES, India policies, established KPIs and the service agreement; conduct quarterly review meetings with the service provider, liaise as required. Coordinate and support the School Safeguarding focal point in the implementation and execution of the Safeguarding policy under the guidance of the AKES, India Safeguarding Lead. Actively participate in monthly security coordination cell (SCC) meetings. 
 Training and Briefings: Deliver or coordinate safety and security workshop/ training and drills for AKES, India personnel Conduct or coordinate safety and security training for security guards, housekeeping staff and drivers on a regular basis Develop and implement capacity building for any staff undertaking security and safety functions, full or part time. Deliver student safety, security and safeguarding awareness programs under the guidance of the AKES, India Safeguarding Lead, including induction and briefing of all new employees on these. Stay informed about current trends, best practices, and legal requirements related to school safety and security, and recommend updates to policies and procedures as needed. Ensure the statutory standards for fire and first aid preparedness are met and that provision for fire and first aid training is made where applicable. Private Security Management Advice on the selection of sub- contracted security service companies (guards/technical security/response) and managing such contracts to ensure the operational requirement stated by AKES, I and AKAH SLT is properly met. Manage the activities and performance of contracted private security providers in accordance with AKES, I and AKAH policies, established KPIs, and the service agreement. Conduct monthly and quarterly review meetings with the private security company. Liaise with the private security company as required. 
 Support: Investigate safety and security breaches and non-compliance. Ensure that the required documentation is maintained, retained, and stored at all schools regarding Safety, Security and Safeguarding including training conducted, communications done, all reports generated, etc. Produce reports, attend meetings, and undertake any other duties, in line with the position, as required by the supervisors. 
 Preferred candidate profile: 
 Qualification: Bachelors degree preferably in security studies or security risk management Minimum bachelors degree or equivalent, in arts and science discipline or security sector related qualification at a degree level. 
 Experience: Minimum 5 years of previous experience in Security/Armed or such allied forces Preference will be given to experience in safety and security management in the Education industry, at a similar level. High level of contextual understanding of the political, social, economic, and security situation in India. Ability to undertake regular in-country travel to operational areas (40%). Previous risk management experience with the UN or NGOs/INGOs in India, or a strong background in educationrelated security. Relevant security industry certifications such as CPP PSP APP – PMP etc.

Key Skills: Security Management,Army Retired,Security Training,CCTV Monitoring,Safety Management,security manager,safety manager,Corporate Security

Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst
As the **Business Analyst – eCommerce**, you will play a key role in driving solution\-oriented changes across the Commercial Department and improving the overall efficiency of the eCommerce domain. You will be responsible for researching, analyzing, and developing data\-driven business cases that support process optimization, cost reduction, new business opportunities, and strategic improvements.

  

You will work closely with the Manager Commercial Projects, Lead Product Owner, Project Managers, Product Owners, and cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service. You will translate business needs and opportunities into well\-defined business cases, including scope, solution options, expected impact, resource requirements, and budget considerations, enabling effective decision\-making and implementation.

 **You will:**

* **Business Case Development:** Research, analyze, and prepare solution\-oriented business cases for new initiatives, process improvements, eCommerce enhancements, and strategic changes.
* **eCommerce Optimization:** Identify opportunities to improve eCommerce efficiency through process optimization, cost reduction, technology enhancements, and identification of new business opportunities.
* **Market \& Competitor Research:** Conduct market research using available tools and resources to assess new features, industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor approaches.
* **Data Analysis:** Gather and analyze relevant business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, challenges, and potential solutions that support informed decision\-making.
* **Solution Identification:** Evaluate existing eCommerce technology platforms, applications, and emerging technologies to determine potential solutions and expected business outcomes.
* **Innovative Solutions:** Develop innovative solutions for operational and strategic improvements and identify the processes, systems, and capabilities required to implement proposed changes.
* **Requirements Management:** Work closely with business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to understand, document, analyze, and validate critical business requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Align and communicate new ideas, business cases, recommendations, expected benefits, risks, and potential impacts with stakeholders and senior management.
* **Business Case Communication:** Prepare reports, presentations, and business case documentation that clearly communicate proposed changes, solution options, expected outcomes, costs, risks, and business impact.
* **Performance \& Impact Assessment:** Forecast the potential impact of proposed solutions and provide regular reporting on business cases, initiatives, and project performance.
* **Project Assessment:** Conduct critical and efficient assessments of eCommerce projects to evaluate their effectiveness, business value, performance, and alignment with organizational objectives.
* **Product Owner Alignment:** Collaborate with Product Owners to assess and align the development resources, capabilities, and priorities required to deliver each proposed solution.
* **Scope \& Planning:** Define project scope, support workforce planning, forecast budgets, and assess and manage change requests associated with business cases and initiatives.
* **Testing \& Validation:** Conduct or coordinate tests, surveys, workshops, and other validation activities to assess proposed solutions and gather stakeholder feedback.
* **Decision Support:** Evaluate inputs from multiple stakeholders, analyze business situations, identify potential alternatives, and recommend the most appropriate course of action.
* **Process Management:** Design and establish new processes, systems, or operating models required to implement approved eCommerce changes and improvements.
* **Progress \& Escalation:** Align regularly with the Manager Commercial Projects and Lead Product Owner on business case progress, challenges, dependencies, and impediments, escalating issues when research or deliverables fall behind schedule.
* **Change Management:** Support and drive business change within an agile environment, ensuring proposed changes are clearly understood, assessed, communicated, and aligned with business objectives.
* **Post\-Implementation Support:** Support Project Managers in assessing the performance and effectiveness of rolled\-out projects to ensure critical and efficient evaluation of eCommerce initiatives.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with teams across the Commercial Department, including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service, to ensure proposed solutions address business needs across the eCommerce ecosystem.

 **You have:**

* **Experience:** 4–7 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, eCommerce, digital transformation, project/change management, or a related field.
* **Education:** University\-level education in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* **Business Analysis Expertise:** Strong understanding of business analysis processes, including requirements gathering, research, data analysis, solution assessment, business case development, and impact evaluation.
* **eCommerce Understanding:** Good understanding of eCommerce environments, business processes, digital platforms, technology solutions, and emerging industry trends.
* **Agile Experience:** Demonstrated track record of working in an agile organization and supporting or driving business and process changes in an agile environment.
* **Data \& Analytical Skills:** Strong data analysis, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data and research into actionable business recommendations.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to understand business objectives, evaluate multiple solution options, identify opportunities, and develop innovative solutions that deliver measurable business value.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate recommendations to senior\-level management.
* **Communication \& Reporting:** Strong ability to prepare business reports, presentations, business cases, and management updates that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and expected business impact.
* **Decision\-Making:** Ability to assess diverse stakeholder inputs, analyze complex situations, evaluate implications, and select appropriate plans of action.
* **Project \& Change Management:** Understanding of project scope, resource planning, budget forecasting, change requests, and change management processes.
* **Technical Skills:** Ability to quickly learn and work with new systems, software, eCommerce platforms, analytical tools, and emerging technologies.
* **Research Skills:** Ability to independently conduct market research, competitor analysis, surveys, workshops, and other forms of business research.
* **Collaboration:** Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across interdisciplinary and cross\-functional teams.
* **Independence:** Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced digital and eCommerce environment while managing multiple business cases simultaneously.
* **Language:** Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Key Competencies:** Problem\-solving, strategic planning, process improvement, data analysis, decision\-making, stakeholder management, teamwork, technical aptitude, reporting, and managerial capabilities.

title: Sr Associate Data Analytics & Reporting
description:
ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the worlds toughest diseases, and make peoples lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond whats known today. ABOUT THE ROLE The Engineering Data Analysis & Reporting Analyst is an individual contributor role responsible for delivering trusted, standardized analytics, reporting, and insights across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Engineering Operations Services (EOS) domains. This role enables data-driven decision-making by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, KPI frameworks, and analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into operational performance, compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Reporting to the Engineering Data analysis and Reporting Lead, this role partners closely with Engineering, EHS, EOS, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to ensure reporting solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise data and analytics strategies. The role will leverage Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Power BI, and Tableau platforms to integrate data, build reporting solutions, and maintain KPI governance standards. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Develop, maintain, and enhance standardized dashboards, scorecards, and reports supporting EHS and EOS governance, operational performance, compliance monitoring, and business decision-making. Design and implement interactive reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and Microsoft Fabric to provide actionable business insights. Integrate and transform data from Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Databricks, enterprise applications, and other data sources to create scalable reporting and analytics solutions. Build and maintain datasets, semantic models, and reporting layers that ensure consistent KPI calculations and reporting standards across EHS and EOS. Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the EHS and EOS KPI Registry, including KPI definitions, business rules, calculations, ownership, targets, thresholds, source systems, and reporting governance. Define, document, and maintain leading and lagging indicators that support proactive risk management, operational performance monitoring, and compliance reporting. Support the Data Analysis and Reporting Lead in managing and maintaining SharePoint sites, reporting content, document libraries, permissions, and data resources; requires proficiency in SharePoint administration, information architecture, data organization, access management, and stakeholder support. Ensure analytics and reporting solutions are accurate, traceable, validated, and audit ready. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure data integrity and reporting reliability. Translate business, operational, compliance, and stakeholder requirements into reporting and analytics solutions. Analyze data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and emerging signals that support continuous improvement initiatives. Develop executive-level reporting, management scorecards, and ad-hoc analytics to support strategic and operational decision-making. Collaborate with Systems, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to improve data quality, governance, and reporting capabilities. Support reporting governance processes, KPI standardization, metric alignment, and reporting best practices. Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes, streamline workflows, and improve reporting efficiency through analytics and technology solutions. Create and maintain reporting documentation, data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and process documentation to support sustainable operations and knowledge management.
